# Hummingbird

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A lightweight, Swift-native server-side web framework for building HTTP APIs and services.

## Scope note

Use for Swift-based server/API components, as a Swift-side counterpart to FastAPI.
